title: Plasma gelsolin attenuates acute tissue inflammation and modulates monocyte responses in experimental candidemia.
snippet: Systemic() infections remain a significant cause of morbidity and mortality in immunocompromised patients, owing to both fungal proliferation and dysregulated host inflammation. Plasma gelsolin (pGSN), an actin-binding protein with immunomodulatory properties, has demonstrated protective effects in bacterial sepsis models, but its role in fungal infections....
